selection: fixed common 40000 steps; no per-model best checkpoint selection or extension
monitoring: 8 deterministic evenly spaced valid Z slices per dev region, full original XY, TTA OFF
final_validation: every valid dev Z slice, full original XY, unchanged MV1 sliding256 stride128 mean-softmax threshold0.5; no postprocessing
sampling: uniform source; uniform legal annotated Z across all train regions within source; shared stateless SeedSequence(seed,step)
masked_background_sampling: center on a uniformly selected valid pixel when annotation mask exists; never sample an all-ignore patch
normalization: (uint8/255-0.5)/0.25; grayscale repeated RGB; native spacing without resampling
loss: cross_entropy(ignore_index=-1)+soft foreground Dice on valid pixels only
schedule: shared cosine with minimum factor0.1 over40000 steps
ignore_distance_policy: reuse MV2 valid surfaces excluding one-voxel ignore adjacency; no fake ignore boundary
additional_seeds_after: first seed both models full-source final validation and metrics complete
stop_after: D12 first-seed results; no auto next experiment
